interject_note: Directly measured, no longer inferred. The previous value here was false and that measurement was invalid: it staged the message with ValuePattern.SetValue, which updates the visual editor without firing the web app's input event -- so the client still believed its composer was empty, Enter was swallowed, and no message was ever queued. With nothing queued there is nothing to interject into, and the absence of a 插话 control was read as 'this client has no interject channel'. Measured properly on this build (pid <local>, 2026-11-05 09:57): a run was started with AEP-START-20261105-01, the client reported activity_state=busy (busy_hits=正在执行), and `aep coord-uia deliver --urgent-interject` then returned status=message-visible, task_delivered=true, promote_after_send=true, interject_polls=1, interject_action=插话, interject_promoted=true, interruption=false, send_attempts=3, send_retry=paste+enter. AEP-INTERJECT-20261105-04 appears in the history at 09:57 and the model itself replied at the top of its next message with 'AEP-INTERJECT-20261105-04 已收到，国际版插话路径验证通过。', while noting the original task had been delivered in the same turn -- so the queued message was read by the running turn, not merely appended after it. Identical to the CN build, same version, same shell. Two things are specific to this build: its window had been left collapsed at 237x39 (deliver now honours the profile's maximize_window like capture and compose already did), and it embeds a browser panel, so the on-screen action-label inventory contains 后退/前进/重新加载/关闭 ... 标签页 as well -- the hint list must stay specific enough not to match a page control.
